title: Maddie Pie
method: Preheat oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Sauté chopped onion in butter for 5 mins.
Stir in flour and crumbled stock cube to make a roux; cook out 2 mins.
Gradually whisk in warm milk until smooth and thickened. Season with salt, pepper, nutmeg, mustard.
Stir in chopped cooked chicken and vegetables. Transfer into a pie dish.
Roll puff pastry over dish, crimp edges, cut steam hole, and brush with egg wash.
Bake for 25 minutes until golden brown.
